visualCharacteristics.backdrop: light-blue vertical gradient (#dcefff -> #8bccf8); source uses a background_image.png over a hidden navy #1e3566 fallback — rendered appearance is light blue, not navy
visualCharacteristics.cta: square transparent button, 2px solid green #04e255 border (in-card 'Read More'); white-outline square for section-level 'View all news'

contentPattern.structure: per card: article image + date + headline + Read More CTA

suitableFor: news / press-release listings on light backgrounds
article or blog card grids with image + date + headline + CTA
notSuitableFor: image-led navigation/category tiles without dates or CTAs
